The Story

I am David Ewa Henshaw — founder of Otuewa International, a performing arts company built on storytelling and the power of live performance.

My journey into the arts began with a deep appreciation for culture and a belief that artistic expression has the power to unite people across backgrounds, languages, and borders.

Beyond the stage, I bring a designer's eye to everything I touch — from clothing and accessories to crafted art pieces. I see beauty in every creation, working with my team to give meaning and soul to every work we produce.
